item.title: 3 Surfers Who Made the Biggest Jumps Towards Championship Tour Qualification at Pipeline
item.description: There were a handful of surfers whose results at Pipeline moved them within arm's reach of locking up a Championship Tour campaign. Here they are.

item.title: We Asked the Talented Shane Borland If He’s a Surfer Who Skates, or a Skater Who Surfs
item.description: Shane Borland is a surfer and skater known for his hard-charging, fully committed airs, and seamless style between boardsports. But which sport came first?

item.title: Here Are the Top 10 Ski and Snowboard TV Episodes of All Time
item.description: Whether you’re looking for a laugh, or just want to get excited about the season, here are 10 of the best ski- and snowboard-themed episodes of television.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn Airlifted From Olympic Downhill Race After Second Ugly Crash
item.description: Lindsey Vonn crashed badly during the Women's downhill race at the Olympics and was airlifted from the mountain just a few days after a similar crash.

item.title: Stranded Surfer Survives by Clinging to Lobster Trap Until Rescuers Arrive
item.description: A Santa Barbara surfer was rescued after losing his board and clinging to a lobster trap for life.

item.title: A Sweet Ride For The Rest Of Us: The Ride Moderator Review
item.description: The Ride Moderator was a sneaky favorite for a versatile, approachable all-mountain snowboard. Our team loved this board in a variety of conditions.

item.title: Olympians Defend Skier Hunter Hess After Donald Trump Attacks Him on Social Media
item.description: Freestyle skier Hunter Hess has come under fire from conservatives, including President Trump himself, after being asked to comment on United States politics.

item.title: Shane Dorian on What It Takes to Surf Big Waves Into Your 40s and 50s
item.description: Shane Dorian has done it all in surfing: the Championship Tour, the Big Wave World Tour, Hollywood movies. We asked him about the keys to surfing longevity.

item.title: Boat Barrels Through Steamer Lane Lineup and Capsizes, Surfers Rescue Occupants
item.description: A boat speeding through the lineup of the popular surf break at Steamer Lane capsized in high surf this weekend, prompting a frantic rescue.

item.title: Big Wave Surfer Justine Dupont Fractures Vertebrae During Thriller at Killers Event
item.description: Big wave surfer Justine Dupont endured a brutal back injury during the Thriller at Killers competition, as she explained in a social media post.
